svg.title: SvelteKit on cPanel — what blocks your API
svg.desc: Flowchart showing how a browser request reaches cPanel static hosting and why server-side routes fail

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the browser request look like for SvelteKit routes?')
sendPrompt('What files does SvelteKit static adapter generate?')
sendPrompt('What does the SvelteKit .htaccess fallback do?')
sendPrompt('Why does SvelteKit return index.html instead of JSON?')
g.text: HTML page sent as the response

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Why does __data.json get HTML instead of JSON?')
sendPrompt('Why do SvelteKit API routes not work on cPanel?')

svg.text: cPanel only serves static files. Your +page.server.ts
and +server.ts need a live Node.js process to execute.
